briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: This hour, multiple investigations and concerns emerged across Minnesota and other states. Notably, Medicaid fraud fears are growing due to a massive red state billing spike, which also affected Minnesota. Additionally, federal investigations are underway into Houston ISD's treatment of disabled students and special education services. A new Office of Inspector General has been created in Minnesota to combat fraud, and a lawsuit has been filed against a Minneapolis crime prevention group for alleged fraud. These developments indicate a rise in suspected fraudulent activities and increased scrutiny from authorities.
